The strongest setups are relapses, with ALLO and CTSI adding post-pump risk. I reviewed 72-hour paths and episode histories for 24 candidates; no quiet contracts met the under-45-day listing screen.

I’m anchoring probabilities to the 10.5% quiet-coin base rate and roughly 26–33% repeat-offender rates, rather than treating intraday predicted dips as settled hits. The ranking also weights potential duration and depth, so it is not ordered by hit probability alone. Pair-removal notices suggest possible arbitrage friction, but do not establish that all spot trading or borrowing is unavailable.

picks.reason: 58 deep days in 90 and only 13 days since the last deep print support relapse; premium deteriorated to -0.1652%, predicted funding dipped to -0.1318%, and Bybit is -0.0556% despite Binance remaining quiet. Spot volume is only $0.514M versus 7.53x perp/spot turnover, and prior episodes included 50.8 days and a recent -1.452% print, supporting substantial duration/depth despite OI deleveraging.

60 deep days in 90, a 20-day cooling period, price down 43.86% over 30 days and supply up 3.30% favor renewed hedging pressure against only $0.252M daily spot volume and 9.63x daily perp/spot turnover. Premium remains -0.1169% and Bybit funding -0.0384%; the historical 56-day episode supports a large depth tail, but muted current volume and shallow settled funding limit hit confidence.

Just eight days since its last deep episode, ALT has renewed deterioration: predicted funding -0.0699%, intraday minimum -0.1535%, premium -0.1955%, and Hyperliquid -0.0406%. Supply increased 3.91% and OI/mcap is 10.67%; the May 21–31 episode paid 7.69% with a -2.394% trough, supporting multi-day relapse potential rather than merely a threshold touch.

A 216.79% monthly run and 84.00% three-day rise have broken into a 24.58% daily decline, while OI remains up 72.08% over three days at 31.31% of market cap and daily perp/spot turnover is 12.25x. Latest 12-hour premium weakened to -0.111% and settled funding reached -0.0256%; the post-pump setup has a large depth tail, but a 47.35% daily OI flush and only two recent deep days warrant a restrained hit probability.

31 deep days, only nine days since the last one, a monitoring tag and OI equal to 33.47% of a $5.16M market cap make this a structurally vulnerable relapse candidate after a 69.93% 60-day decline. Intraday prediction reached -0.1862% and historical episodes lasted 24–30 days, but positive current premium and prediction temper confidence in immediate pressure.

The screen explicitly flags CHIP quiet with min7 -0.0904%, although current predicted funding is missing; it has 31 deep days in its 52.7-day life and only an 11-day cooling period. Price is down 56.82% monthly, premium is persistently around -0.134%, and OI/mcap is 11.47%; prior 9.3- and 15.8-day episodes support persistent depth, with missing predictions and falling OI reducing confidence.

Price rose 21.24% weekly while the perp traded at a persistent roughly -0.23% to -0.34% discount across the hourly buckets, with predicted funding newly dipping to -0.055% and supply up 3.27%. A $35.65M market cap, 24 prior deep days and a historical 14.5-day episode with a -4.0% trough support squeeze-driven depth, although settled funding remains +0.01% and OI is unavailable.

Only 16 days after its last deep print, PROVE's premium worsened from -0.144% to -0.259% across the 72-hour buckets, with predicted funding dipping to -0.0797% as price fell 33.93% monthly. Spot turnover is $0.527M against 6.01x daily perp/spot volume and OI/mcap is 9.08%; the recent 1.7-day episode paid 6.18% with a -4% trough, providing depth upside despite currently positive settlements.

Margin-pair removal effective June 5 adds potential arbitrage friction while circulating supply grew 9.24%, price fell 47.34% monthly and the last deep day was only eight days ago. Premium is -0.1766%, Bybit/Hyperliquid funding is -0.0231%/-0.0427%, and OI recovered from $2.507M to $2.662M during the latest price weakness; recent multi-day episodes support persistence, though predicted pressure has eased.

40 deep days in 90, a 19-day cooling period and a 21.50% weekly decline favor relapse against exceptionally thin $0.108M spot turnover, 12.95x daily perp/spot volume and 12.55% OI/mcap. Premium remains -0.1681% and hourly predictions reached -0.3098% on June 6, but the latest predicted mean improved and Bybit is positive, limiting the probability and depth ranking.

Predicted funding is -0.0807% with a -0.1526% intraday low, while daily spot volume is just $0.209M versus 11.68x perp/spot turnover after a 34.04% monthly decline. Fifteen recent deep days and prior episodes paying 9.86% and 4.86% support a meaningful depth tail, but improving predicted means and positive other-venue funding argue against a higher hit estimate.

26 deep days, a $12.15M market cap, 17.36% OI/mcap and a 46.83% monthly decline create relapse susceptibility; hourly predicted minima deteriorated to -0.1177% and daily perp/spot turnover is 6.86x. Previous episodes paid 12.67% over 13.5 days and 11.64% over 3.8 days, but positive current premium and +0.01% settlements make this a depth-tail selection rather than a confirmed onset.

Monitoring-tagged GTC has a $6.59M market cap, 17.07% OI/mcap and only $0.284M daily spot turnover; premium is -0.2916% on average and -0.5132% currently, while the predicted 24-hour mean fell to -0.1276%. Its previous pump produced a -1.293% settled trough, but frequent historical predicted dips failed to settle deeply negative and the latest settlement is +0.0406%, so the probability is heavily discounted.

After the May run-up, NIL is 57.50% below its 30-day high and down 16.95% in three days, with supply up 4.34% and OI/mcap 14.97%. Hourly settlements deteriorated to -0.0753%, predicted funding reached -0.2100% and premium averaged -0.3357%; these are strong onset signals, but historically shorter episodes and the three-day lead time constrain expected in-window depth.

A fresh 9.66% daily pump brought 5.24x normal perp volume and 19.67% OI growth, followed by a retreat from $0.02654 to $0.02452 and a -0.0691% settlement while still quiet. Predicted funding dipped to -0.1148%, daily perp/spot turnover is 6.06x and a May 29 spot-pair removal adds possible friction; the prior 3.3-day episode paid 4.65%, but the latest prediction has reset to +0.01%.
